name: Anniversary ~Natsuyasumi no Omoide~
original_name: アニヴァーサリー ～夏休みの想い出～
source:
Anniversary: Memories of Summer Vacation tells the story of a young girl named Ringo. One night, Ringo witnesses an impish girl named Cherry seducing another girl. At first she feels repulsed, but after a while finds out that she is excited... soon she and Cherry become lovers and soulmates, unaware of the fact that Cherry is being hunted by the authorities...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/anniversary-memories-of-summer-vacation]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Anniversary～暑假回忆～》讲述名叫林檎的少女的故事。某天夜里，林檎目睹一个名叫樱桃、宛如小恶魔的女孩诱惑另一名少女。起初，她对此感到反感；过了一段时间，却发现自己竟然为之兴奋……很快，林檎与樱桃成为恋人，也是心灵相通的伴侣。两人却不知道，当局正在追捕樱桃……

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/anniversary-memories-of-summer-vacation]Moby Games[/url]]
